source.compiledFrom: published press coverage of the guide announcement

restaurants.name: 8½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana
restaurants.address: Shop 202, 2/F, Alexandra House, 18 Chater Road, Central
restaurants.description: Umberto Bombana's Italian flagship in Alexandra House, known for handmade pastas, seasonal white truffle menus and a deep Italian wine cellar; there is also a bar.
restaurants.hoursNote: Bar open from noon until late Mon-Sat

restaurants.name: Amber
restaurants.address: 7/F, The Landmark Mandarin Oriental, 15 Queen's Road Central, Central
restaurants.description: Richard Ekkebus's contemporary French dining room in The Landmark Mandarin Oriental, reworked since 2019 around dairy-light, low-sugar tasting menus and seasonal produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: Windows as listed by the hotel; actual seating times may be narrower

restaurants.name: Caprice
restaurants.address: 6/F, Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong, 8 Finance Street, Central
restaurants.description: French fine dining at the Four Seasons Hotel with harbour views, an open kitchen and a well-known cheese cellar; tasting menus only.
restaurants.hoursNote: times are last orders (lunch 14:00, dinner 20:30)

restaurants.name: Forum
restaurants.address: 1/F, Sino Plaza, 255-257 Gloucester Road, Causeway Bay
restaurants.description: Long-running Cantonese restaurant in Causeway Bay founded by the late chef Yeung Koon-yat, renowned for its braised Ah Yat abalone and classic seafood dishes.

restaurants.name: Sushi Shikon
restaurants.address: 7/F, The Landmark Mandarin Oriental, 15 Queen's Road Central, Central
restaurants.description: Edomae sushi counter from Tokyo master Yoshiharu Kakinuma, run by chef Masahiro Yoshitake, serving omakase with aged fish at a hinoki bar inside The Landmark Mandarin Oriental.
restaurants.hoursNote: Three fixed seatings; Sunday not listed (assumed closed)

restaurants.name: T'ang Court
restaurants.address: 1/F-2/F, The Langham, 8 Peking Road, Tsim Sha Tsui
restaurants.description: Classic Cantonese fine dining on two floors of The Langham in Tsim Sha Tsui, known for baked stuffed crab shell, abalone and refined dim sum at lunch.
restaurants.hoursNote: Public holidays: lunch 11:00-16:00

restaurants.name: Ta Vie
restaurants.address: 2/F, The Pottinger, 74 Queen's Road Central, Central
restaurants.description: Japanese chef Hideaki Sato's intimate dining room in The Pottinger hotel, serving dinner-only tasting menus that blend French technique with Japanese and Asian seasonal produce.
restaurants.hoursNote: Opening days vary by month (check social media); seatings 18:00/19:00/20:00, last order 20:00; Wed closure per Michelin/Time Out

restaurants.name: Arbor
restaurants.address: 25/F, H Queen's, 80 Queen's Road Central, Central
restaurants.description: Nordic-Japanese influenced tasting menus by Finnish chef Eric Räty, set on the 25th floor of the H Queen's art-gallery tower in Central.

restaurants.name: Bo Innovation
restaurants.address: 1/F, H Code, 45 Pottinger Street, Central
restaurants.description: Alvin Leung's flagship in Central, serving playful tasting menus that reinterpret Chinese and Hong Kong flavours with modernist techniques.
restaurants.hoursNote: Some third-party listings show Sunday closed or Monday dinner only

restaurants.name: Cristal Room by Anne-Sophie Pic
restaurants.address: Forty-Five, Gloucester Tower, The Landmark, 15 Queen's Road Central, Central

restaurants.name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon

restaurants.name: L'Envol
restaurants.address: 3/F, The St. Regis Hong Kong, 1 Harbour Drive, Wan Chai

restaurants.name: Lai Ching Heen

restaurants.hoursNote: Public holidays: lunch from 11:30

restaurants.name: Lung King Heen

restaurants.hoursNote: Weekend lunch hours also apply on public holidays; other listings give dinner until 22:30

restaurants.name: Noi by Paulo Airaudo

restaurants.name: Octavium

restaurants.name: Rùn

restaurants.hoursNote: Dinner window as listed on the hotel site

restaurants.name: Tin Lung Heen

restaurants.hoursNote: Weekend two-sitting lunch also applies on public holidays

restaurants.name: Ying Jee Club

restaurants.name: Ami

restaurants.name: Andō

restaurants.name: Arcane

restaurants.name: Beefbar

restaurants.name: Belon

restaurants.name: Chaat

restaurants.name: Duddell's

restaurants.name: Épure

restaurants.name: Estro

restaurants.name: Feuille
